# Synthetic sample corpus

**This entire corpus is synthetic**, generated by `scripts/make_corpus.py`.
No confidential or real organizational documents are included.

Regenerate with: `python scripts/make_corpus.py` (safe to delete `data/sample_documents/*` first;
this file lives outside `sample_documents/` so it is never itself picked up by ingestion).

## Structure and intentional scenarios

- `policies/` — `data-retention-policy-v1.md` (2023-01-10) and `-v2.md` (2024-06-01) describe the
  same policy family with different retention periods; v2 supersedes v1 (FR-12 version/recency).
- `procedures/incident-response-sop.md` — includes an appendix quoting a fabricated vendor ticket
  containing an embedded prompt-injection attempt (adversarial/injection test case, 4.3).
- `technical-guides/api-authentication-guide.md` states a 1000/hour API rate limit; independently,
  `architecture/system-architecture.md` states a 500/hour gateway rate limit. These are two
  distinct, both-current documents that genuinely disagree (FR-13 contradiction test) — not a
  version-supersession case.
- `technical-guides/vendor-integration-notes.md` — a second, differently-styled embedded
  injection attempt (fenced "SYSTEM:" directive) for adversarial-question coverage.
- `release-notes/release-notes-2.3.md` / `-2.4.md` — 2.4 supersedes 2.3 (timeout 30s -> 60s), but
  2.4 itself notes that legacy SDK clients still see the old value — a conflict that survives
  version resolution.
- `malformed_samples/` — exercises FR-02 robust parsing: `empty-file.txt` (empty),
  `unsupported-format.rtf` (unsupported extension), `corrupted-fake.pdf` (not a real PDF),
  `encrypted-confidential.pdf` (password-protected, no password given to the assistant), and
  `data-retention-policy-v1-copy.md` (byte-for-byte duplicate of `policies/data-retention-policy-v1.md`
  under a different name, for duplicate-content detection).
